_readme: 30 test questions for the RAG pipeline over IPC.pdf, already indexed in the dev database as document 'IPC'
Every section number below was verified against the indexed text before writing the question (see
tests/section_check.txt for the grep evidence). No section numbers or IPC content were invented.
question           what is sent to the pipeline, verbatim (typos are intentional, not fixed)
expected_behavior  'answer' (the IPC covers this) or 'refuse' (it genuinely does not)
expected_sections  IPC sections whose content answers the question. For 'answer' cases, a verified answer
must cite at least one of these; it does not need to cite all of them, since several
are given for genuinely multi-section questions. Empty for 'refuse' cases.
must_not_cite       sections that would be a specific, checkable mistake if cited (e.g. a value threshold
the question's amount does not meet). Empty list if not applicable.
tags                typo | amount | plain_language | multi_section | technical | unanswerable
note                why this is a refuse case, or what the question is testing, for the grader/reader

questions.question: what happens if someone stealls a bike worth 50,000 rupees
questions.note: theft; the general punishment (379) does not vary by the value of the stolen property

questions.question: What is the punishment under section 302 IPC?
questions.note: direct section lookup: punishment for murder

questions.question: a man forced himself on a woman without her consent, what is the punishment
questions.note: rape, described without the legal term

questions.question: what is the punishment for mischeif that causes damage to propery worth 40 rupees
questions.note: section 427 needs damage of fifty rupees OR MORE; 40 rupees falls under the general mischief

questions.question: what is the punishment for theft of 1 lakh rupees
questions.note: same family as q01 and q15: theft's punishment does not depend on the amount stolen

questions.question: what is the difference between robbery and dacoity
questions.note: dacoity (391) is robbery (390) committed by five or more people; needs both definitions

questions.question: what's the difference between theft and extortion
questions.note: theft takes property without consent; extortion gets consent through fear of injury

questions.question: my neighbour deliberately broke my fence on purpose, what can happen to him
questions.note: mischief, with no value given, so only the general punishment (426) applies

questions.question: what is culpable homicide not amounting to murder
questions.note: 299 defines culpable homicide; 304 is the punishment when it is not murder

questions.question: what is the punishment for dowry death
questions.note: direct section lookup

questions.question: a shopkeeper cheated a customer out of 2 lakh rupees by lying about a product, what is the punishment
questions.note: cheating that induces delivery of property; 420's punishment does not depend on the amount

questions.question: what is the punishment for kidnaping a child
questions.note: plain kidnapping (363), not the aggravated 'for begging' form (363A), which the question does not describe

questions.question: what is section 420 IPC
questions.note: direct section lookup

questions.question: what is the punishment for causing grievous hurt with a dangerous weapon
questions.note: direct match, in legal-ish plain language

questions.question: what is the punishment for cheating someone of 5 lac rupees
questions.note: same family as q11; 'lac' is a common alternate spelling of 'lakh'

questions.question: a man assaulted a woman to outrage her modesty, what is the punishment
questions.note: direct match, question already uses the section's own wording

questions.question: what is criminal conspiracy and what is its punishment
questions.note: 120A defines it, 120B punishes it; a complete answer needs both

questions.question: if five people together rob someone is that dacoity
questions.note: 391 sets the five-or-more threshold; 392 is robbery's own punishment for comparison

questions.question: what is the punishment for forging a document in order to cheat someone
questions.note: forgery for the specific purpose of cheating has its own section, distinct from plain forgery (463-465)

questions.question: a man threatened to kill my family unless I paid him money, what crime is this
questions.note: extortion by threat of death (383, 386) is the central offence; criminal intimidation (503, 506) also fits the threat itself. Accept an answer that covers extortion, with or without also naming intimidation.

questions.question: is an act done by a person of unsound mind a crime
questions.note: general exception, not an offence; tests that the pipeline still answers when the question has no 'offence'

questions.question: a servant stole money from his employer, what is the punishment
questions.note: theft by a clerk or servant (381) is the specific provision; 379 is the general theft punishment it refers to

questions.question: what is defamation and what is its punishment
questions.note: 499 defines it, 500 punishes it

questions.question: what is the punishment for wrongful confinement
questions.note: 340 defines it, 342 is the base punishment (343-348 are aggravated forms the question does not ask about)

questions.question: a man is stalking a woman repeatedly after she told him to stop, is that a crime
questions.note: direct match to the stalking section, in plain language

questions.question: what are the legal remedies if someone breaches a business contract
questions.note: civil contract remedies are in the Indian Contract Act and civil procedure, not the IPC (criminal law)

questions.question: what is the procedure to register a trademark in India
questions.note: trademark registration is under the Trade Marks Act, administered by the Trade Marks Registry, not the IPC

questions.question: how do I file for divorce in India
questions.note: divorce procedure is personal law (e.g. the Hindu Marriage Act, the Special Marriage Act), not the IPC

questions.question: what is the fine for overspeeding on a highway
questions.note: traffic fines are under the Motor Vehicles Act, not the IPC

questions.question: what is the punishment for a government official who accepts a bribe
questions.note: a deliberate trap: sections 161 to 165A (bribery by public servants) are marked '[Repealed.]' in this indexed text (moved to the Prevention of Corruption Act). The IPC itself states no punishment, so the correct behavior is to refuse, not to answer from the nearby sections (e.g. 166, which is about disobeying the law, not bribery).
